Steps for comfort stops
This article is for guests

Comfort Stops for Traveling Pets

Use comfort stops to help a pet settle, drink, and relieve itself before boarding or during a longer airport wait. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways keeps the process orderly so travelers can move through each step with less stress.

Begin by checking whether the pet needs a break before security or after check-in. A passenger coordinator will review the required travel steps and direct you to the proper area. Keep the pet on a secure lead or in the approved carrier while you move through the terminal, and keep documents ready for inspection.

When you reach the pet relief area, follow the posted signs and keep your pet under close watch. <<FACT F016>> Use the area only for its intended purpose, and remove waste at once. If the floor is wet or crowded, wait for a clearer space so the pet can move safely.

If a traveler prefers a lounge stop, the welcome team will guide the pet to the correct location and explain the routine. <<FACT F019>> Bring water, cleaning supplies, and any approved comfort item you normally carry. Keep the visit calm and brief, and leave the area tidy for the next guest.

If a pet appears uneasy, ask for help at once. The supervisory staff listens carefully when a passenger is concerned and can suggest a quieter route, a safer hold point, or another comfort stop before boarding. <<FACT F005>> Follow the guidance given by the desk so the pet stays settled and the travel record remains in order.

For further help, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways before you continue to the gate.
